variationAxes.V1_Transform: Position jitter, yaw rotation, slope-aligned tilt limit, uniform/bounded non-uniform scale
variationAxes.V2_DamageState: Pristine / Worn / Damaged / Ruined geometry states and broken sub-parts
variationAxes.V3_Construction: Structural assembly variants (e.g., closed plank vs open slat crate, upright vs tipped barrel)
variationAxes.V4_MaterialWeathering: Material swap list plus per-instance tint, edge wear, grime, and rust
variationAxes.V5_ContentsAttachment: Optional toggleable attachments (ropes, labels, spilled goods, fasteners)
variationAxes.V6_ClusterSpread: Spatial grouping rule (Single, StackedGrid, Huddled, RadialScatter, DirectionalCone, WallSkirt)
variationAxes.V7_BiomeOvergrowth: Shader-driven environmental blend (TopDust, TopSnow, MossMask, GroundSkirtBlend)
